title: Can You Drink Alcohol And Still Have Abs? (My 6 Rules)
hook: Can you drink alcohol and still have six pack abs? Yes, but only if you put rules on it.
body:
My 6 rules for drinking and keeping your abs:
1. Eat first, then drink.
2. Count the calories.

4. Cap it at 1 or 2 nights a week.
5. Stop 3 hours before bed.

close: Save this before your next night out.
youtube_description:
Can you drink alcohol and still have six pack abs? Yes, but only if you put rules on it. Here is exactly what alcohol does to your body, and the 6 rules I follow so I can still drink and keep my abs.

See what you'd look like with a six-pack, free:
https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=longform&utm_content=ro13-alcohol-and-abs

What alcohol really does: it is pure liquid calories (7 per gram), it wrecks your sleep quality, it lowers your inhibitions so you eat more, and it puts recovery and testosterone on hold while your body deals with it.

My 6 rules for drinking and keeping your abs:
1. Eat first. Never drink in your fasting window or with your first meal, and wait at least 30 minutes after you break your fast.
2. Count the calories. A real night out is 1,000 calories or more, and they count whether you write them down or not.
3. Kill the sugary mixers. Dry wine or spirits with soda water and lime.
4. Cap your nights. One drinking occasion a week, two at the absolute maximum.
5. Stop 3 hours before bed. It is the single highest return rule on the list.
6. Run your normal fast the next morning. One bad night is recoverable, a bad weekend is not.

I also share the honest truth about where I landed: how much I used to drink, what I do now, and how Zepbound changed my desire to drink. Not medical advice. Talk to your doctor before you start any medication.
